It opened in July 1993,
against summer
blockbusters, and
lost money.

It only became a classic
because it ran on TV
every October until a
generation assumed
it always had.

It didn't get better.
It got found.

She's 19, and she only
just became the
main character.

their window.

source: Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica; Winchester Mystery House records · HAL-016

beats.html:
She is never going
to explain herself.

Sarah Winchester built
a house for 35 years
and never once
said why.

Bought it in 1886, kept
building until she
died in 1922.

Every ghost story about
that house was written
after she was dead, by
people who couldn't
stand not knowing.

People will build you a
whole haunted house
rather than accept
the silence.

Robert L. May wrote him
in 1939 as a free
giveaway booklet for

He was in debt. His wife
was dying. That was
the year he wrote it.

The most cheerful
character of the season
came out of the worst
year of a man's life.

About being the one
who doesn't fit.

Send this to whoever
is building something
in a hard year.
